function.name: deliver_document
function.description: Attach an original indexed file when requested, using its exact observed path (search_documents first if unknown). Returns a local reference, metadata and hash; does not open, copy or upload the file.

function.name: search_documents
function.description: Find indexed local files by filename, subject or content keywords; retry irrelevant results. Returns metadata only. Read contents with read_document or read_book_page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5).
